task: Before predicting how R1 forwards a packet, display its complete installed IPv4 routing table, including all route sources.

teaching.hint: Begin with the complete installed table so a more-specific route is not hidden.
teaching.takeaway: This shows selected routes, not every configured candidate. Choose a packet's longest matching prefix after reading the entries; administrative distance does not override a longer installed match.

task: R1 has a nondefault route covering 10.20.30.150. Request the installed entry that matches this destination so you can read its prefix and next hop.

teaching.hint: A destination-specific lookup takes the packet's address, not a guessed network address.
teaching.takeaway: Use the returned prefix to explain the forwarding choice. If only a default should apply, inspect the full table as well because destination-lookup display behavior varies by IOS image.
